Widget family: TAB BAR

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A horizontal strip of two or more tab labels is visible.
2. The selected/active tab is visually distinct from unselected tabs (different fill, border accent, and/or brighter label text).
3. Tab labels read as text inside their tab bounds when claimed.
4. FAIL if: only one tab appears, selected and unselected tabs look identical, or no tab strip is present.
